title: Kohtalee's Origins
description:
A datapack that adds 3 new origins to the origins mod!

(PEHKUI AND ORIGINS REQUIRED!!!)
body:
Adds 3 new Origins to the Origins Fabric Mod, in which 2 are animals, as for the other, there is a special dimension for that.

***THIS MOD REQUIRES PEHKUI AND THE BASE ORIGINS MOD***

Origins are below:

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Snow Leopard:**

Impact: 2

**Powers:**

 - Short
   - You are much slightly shorter than the average player.
 - Quick
   - Due to your environment, you have evolved to be fast to catch any runaway prey.
 - Nimble
   - Your arms have evolved to be quicker than usual..
 - Pounce
   - You are able to attack and catch prey by pouncing on them, by launching in the direction you are looking!.
 - Soft Feet
   - Due to how your feline-like legs, you don't take fall damage..

**Drawbacks:**

 - Weak arms
   - Your arms are weak, and have trouble breaking things.
 - Carnivorous
   - Your diet doesn't allow you to eat anything other than meat.
 - Fragile
   - As a result of your increased speed, you can't really afford more health. (-2.5 Hearts).
 - Inexperienced Swimmer
   - You never really had to swim, as a result, you are really slow in water.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Moth:**

Impact: 2

**Powers:**

- Small
   - You are much smaller than the average player.
- Quick
   - You can use your small size to your advantage, you as a result run faster.
- Wings
   - Since you are a moth, you have wings.
- Soft Land
   - Due to your size, you don't take fall damage.
- Flap
   - Launch yourself up!
- Light Attracted
   - You enjoy the light, so much so that near powerful, isolated light sources, you regenerate.

**Drawbacks:**

- Herbivore
   - Your diet doesn't allow you to eat meat.
- Frail
   - As a result of your size, you have only 7 hearts.
- Inexperienced Swimmer
   - You never really had to swim, as a result, you are really slow in water.
- Weak
   - You can't hit that hard, so you deal 15% less damage.
- Weak arms
   - Your arms are weak, and have trouble breaking things.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Quantumizer:**

Impact: 3

**Powers:**

- Quantum Shift
   - You are able to transport yourself and others into the quantum realm and back, at the cost of your hunger.
- Quantum Tunneling
   - You are able to phase through solid matter for a brief period of time, unless you are in the Quantum Realm.
- Quark Charge
   - If you right click without anything in your hand, and while crouching, you will fire a projectile.

**Drawbacks:**

- Strange Diet
   - You cannot eat any normal food, instead your diet is Amethyst Shards, Glowstone Dust, and Iron Nuggets.
- Fragile
   - You have 1.5 less hearts than normal.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
